<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
The IPVS proxy uses iptables rules as well for things like packet filtering and masquerading traffic. We should have unit tests similart to the iptables proxier for the iptables rules created for the IPVS proxy.  

**Why is this needed**:
More test coverage is always better :)
